environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed on AWS Lambda via custom runtime, behind API Gateway REST API with a Gateway Response configuration of type DEFAULT_4XX and DEFAULT_5XX that appends headers. Additionally, a Lambda@Edge origin-response function (associated via CloudFront distribution ID d-ABC123XYZ) injects response headers using a viewer-response trigger. The CloudFront distribution has a response headers policy (ID: 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03, managed policy 'SecurityHeadersPolicy') which sets Content-Security-Policy to "default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; style-src 'self'" on ALL responses regardless of origin behavior or cache status. The policy is attached at the distribution-level default cache behavior, meaning it applies even to non-cached error responses and cannot be bypassed by manipulating cache keys or origin responses. The symlink creation endpoint /api/link remains functional.
